Politiki y’ibanga

Shift ntikusanya amakuru bwite.

Gukusanya amakuru

Shift ntikusanya, ntibika kandi ntisangiza abandi amakuru bwite. Iyi porogaramu nta konti, amatangazo cyangwa ikoranabuhanga ryo gukurikirana ifite.

Imibare y’imikoreshereze

Kugira ngo Shift irusheho kuba nziza, iyi porogaramu yohereza imibare y’imikoreshereze itagaragaza uwo ari we, nko kumenya igenamiterere rikoreshwa, kumenya niba imyitozo irangira, n’amakuru ya tekiniki mu gihe porogaramu ihagaze bitunguranye. Ntijyamo na rimwe amazina y’imyitozo cyangwa ikindi cyose cyagaragaza uwo uri we, kandi itunganywa na TelemetryDeck.

Igenamiterere › Ibanga

Amakuru abitswe ku gikoresho cyawe

Imyitozo yawe, amateka, igenamiterere n’uko igihe cy’imyitozo gihagaze bibitswe ku gikoresho cyawe. Amajwi avuga ibimenyetso akorwa n’ubwenge buhangano kandi akumvikanira ku gikoresho cyawe.

Kubika no gusiba

Imibare y’imikoreshereze ntigaragaza uwo ari we, bityo ntishobora gukurikiranwa ngo igere kuri wowe cyangwa gusibwa kuri buri muntu. Kuyihagarika bituma itongera koherezwa ako kanya. Gusiba iyi porogaramu bikuraho amakuru ya Shift abitswe ku gikoresho cyawe.

Twandikire kandi ubone ubufasha

Ku bufasha bwa Shift, ibitekerezo cyangwa ibibazo kuri iyi politiki y’ibanga, andikira shift@bysteed.com.
